before.core_behavior: The tail fullmatch, full name-set coverage, pairwise disjointness, observed-list duplicate checks, count comparison and real subprocess exit prevented an ordinary partial or mixed child run from becoming complete.

strictness_findings.detail: Only list lengths 971/23 were asserted before the run; registered/ignored input uniqueness, ignored subset and exact original-name identity were not explicitly checked.

The selected tail ok/FAILED label was parsed but unused, while counts came from a second whole-log regex. strip() on the chosen tail and anchored whole-line matching could disagree on malformed whitespace.

before.additional_identity_note: ELF/source qualification was separate: build-artifact SHA, actual pre-run SHA and binary_unchanged were recorded, but terminal accounting did not assert post-run binary stability.

requirements.detail: The same selected binary provides --list. Exactly 971 unique registered names must equal the frozen original registry. The final outcome union must equal this exact set.

Exactly 23 unique ignored names must be a subset of registered and equal the frozen original ignored-name set. Actual ignored announcements must be unique and equal that set; a declared count alone cannot replace missing identities.
Passed, failed and observed-ignored names require the expected selector spelling, no within-list duplicates, pairwise disjointness and complete exact registry coverage.

The real subprocess returncode must be 101 if failures exist and 0 otherwise. Timeout is explicitly refused. The selected final summary must say FAILED or ok consistently and carry the same three observed counts.

The final suffix must fullmatch one libtest summary. Missing/truncated suffix, a nested child summary lacking the full registry, missing/duplicate identities, timeout, abnormal exit or inconsistent status/counts produces reader_error before complete_original_registry can be set.
Only the selected tail final_summary.groups() supplies final status and counts. The second whole-log summary scan has been removed.

The pre-run executable digest must match the recorded build artifact. The run plan retains hashes of the frozen registry plan and driver. Post-run binary_unchanged is required before terminal accounting is accepted. Final source/build qualification remains a separate main-thread responsibility.

frozen_reference_verification.reference_use: Selector identity only. Historical native outcomes do not qualify the b280 executable.

interpretation_and_limits: complete_original_registry=True certifies accounting completeness, not success. A 947/1/23 run with real exit 101 remains a failed run.
A successful native suite requires complete coverage, no reader_error, not timed_out, exit 0, 948 passed, zero failed and the exact 23 original ignored names, plus the independent source/ELF gates.
If child stdout interrupts an ignored announcement so the identity cannot be reconstructed, this reader fails closed rather than filling it from the declared count.
Python assertions must remain enabled; this review does not qualify a -O or PYTHONOPTIMIZE invocation that removes assert checks.
Libtest stdout and file receipts are observations, not an independent cryptographic execution oracle against a malicious process forging an entire registry and successful process exit.
No current long native run outcome is inferred: plan.json did not exist when the initial and hardened static reviews began.
